profile.summary: MarcoLeko is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in TypeScript generics and Fastify framework contributions. Their work focuses on designing and implementing type-safe abstractions within Fastify’s core request handling system, demonstrating deep knowledge of generic types, backend middleware, and framework architecture. While contributions are backend-focused and primarily involve Fastify’s internals, their PRs indicate a strong ability to refine API contracts and improve type safety without necessarily implementing low-level code changes. No evidence of frontend or testing experience is present in the analyzed PRs.
